articleTitle: Mechatronics Design and Kinematic Analysis of Mecanum Wheeled Mobile Robot for Covid-19 Disinfection with UV Rays applied on Indoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Since 2020, there has been a critical health situation in the entire population of Peru due to the appearance of the COVID-19 virus. People who have to work or leave home, put their families at risk because they can infect or transmit the virus. Therefore, this research, conducted under the supervision of the School of Mechatronics Engineering of the Ricardo Palma University, aims to design a mobile robot that emits ultraviolet-UV rays for the disinfection of rooms in houses, in order to disinfect possible contaminated areas. The robot has a mechanical design that consists of 4 mecanum type wheels and a robotic arm of 2 degrees of freedom -DOF. The motion system is controlled by 4 direct current-DC motors and its respective controller, connected to the Raspberry Pi microprocessor, and it is also powered by 2 batteries of 12 V. The robot's function is to sterilize the virus both with its main structure and its extension. This study presents a mechatronic conceptual design using SolidWorks 2020 software for the development of the 3D mechanical systems, Proteus 8 for the technical schematics of the electrical and electronic circuits, and in addition, MATLAB 2020a for the kinematic motion tests of the robotic platform and Gazebo for the motion simulation. This paper has centered on the study of the platform motion and its mechanical design. In conclusion, due to the good results of the mobile prototype and UV rays as a disinfection method, the integration of the first prototype is planned for February 2022 for its first application in some houses in Peru.

articleTitle: Corporate social responsibility actions in agribusiness: Towards sustainable community development
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The objective of the research is to determine the actions of corporate social responsibility that take advantage of sustainable community development. The methodology used was descriptive with a mixed approach and a non-experimental cross-sectional design. It was carried out with the participation of the workers of the Agroindustrial Paramonga [AIPSA] company. As a result, it was determined that the company carries out social responsibility actions in the social, health and environmental spheres in favor of the community and its workers. Finally, it was found that the activities carried out by the company in 2021 have generated sustainability in the lives of workers and residents of the city of Paramonga.

articleTitle: A systematic literature review on support vector machines applied to regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This article aims to identify the current state of the art of the latest research related to models and algorithms in support vector machines for regression. For that, we use the methodology proposed by Kitchenham and Charter, in order to answer the following research questions: Q1: In which research areas is the support vector machine for regression most used? Q2. What optimization models are used to support vector machine for regression? Q3. What algorithms or optimization methods are used to solve support vector machine for regression? Q4. What nonconvex optimization models use support vector machine for regression? Q5. What optimization algorithms are used for nonconvex models to support vector machine for regression? We obtain valuable information about the questions to construct new models and algorithms in this research area.

articleTitle: A Light Systematic Literature Review on Remote Laboratories for Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This article presents a light systematic literature review focused on how remote laboratories (RLs) are being used in engineering education (EE). To achieve this objective, we analyzed the technologies used and the impact on students. The research methodology followed systematic literature review guidelines adapted from software engineering. We used three indexing databases and support software to execute the methodology. From 672 initial search results, 31 have been considered relevant studies and depicts the current state of the RLs. Most of the studies show the implementation of remote access to the equipment, and do not show the development or adaptation of teaching-learning methodologies for RLs.

articleTitle: Travel influencers as a factor in choosing a tourist destination post covid-19: Analysis of the national tourist
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Tourism in recent years has given Peru greater economic income; However, it is currently one of the sectors most affected by the COVID-19 pandemic that has led to the paralysis of tourist activities, economically affecting the entire sector, this has forced to rethink strategies that contribute to its reactivation; One of them are the so-called travel influencers who have achieved great acceptance among tourists. This event has motivated this study with the aim of analyzing how these digital icons contribute to the reactivation of national (internal) tourism as a factor in choosing the destination. For this, 339 surveys were carried out through a quantitative, descriptive, and cross-sectional approach, the results of which determined that the function they fulfill has a significant impact on this sector through the visual and didactic material they promote.

articleTitle: The Phenomenon of Bullying in relation to the School Coexistence of Students of the 6th Grade of Primary of Public Schools
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: School bullying are aggressive behaviors that an individual exercises towards its victim, the purpose of this research is to identify the characters that predominate in this phenomenon and how it is related to school coexistence in students of the sixth grade of primary school of a Public Educational Institution from Lima Norte (Peru). The sample consisted of 27 students, 14 men (51.9%) and 13 women (48.1%) from 11 to 12 years old (Mean = 11.44, SD = .51) where 10 (37.0%) live with their mother, 2 (7.4%)) with their father and 15 (55.6%) with both parents. Then, the reliability of the scales and the relationship between the variables where aggression and verbal harassment have a significant relationship with contempt and ridicule were analyzed. Likewise, if the attacks and threats are constant, the greater will be the verbal harassment; about school coexistence, it is inversely related to aggressions.

articleTitle: Psychological well-being, coping styles and academic performance in university students during virtual classes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The main objective of the research was to know the relationship between the psychological well-being, the coping styles and the academic performance of the students. The research was quantitative and correlational, the sample consisted of 369 university students from Lima, Peru. The results indicated that psychological well-being has a positive, significant and high correlation with problem-centered coping style and also with academic performance. It was reported that women have higher scores in psychological well-being and academic performance; likewise, it was evidenced that science majors use more strategies focused on problem solving.

articleTitle: A Method to Construct Guidelines for Spanish Comments Annotation for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The application of sentiment analysis in social networks supports the understanding of complaints and claims of users' comments. To train the models that automate this analysis, it is important to construct guidelines that generate a more robust corpus. As far as we know, no related work of guidelines for spanish comments annotation has been found. We propose a method to construct guidelines to annotators reach a consensus in the entire annotation process of spanish comments from social networks. We annotated 3259 spanish comments using our guidelines, where the concordance analysis from our annotators was 84%. We employed our corpus and eight baseline classifiers for sentiment analysis detection, achieving 78.63% as the highest F1-Score with Multilayer Perceptron. Our method is useful to tackle labeling spanish comments which can be used in NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Using Twitter data for consumer research: The Peruvian's consumer perspective on short food supply chains
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Twitter is nowadays an excellent tool for gathering user's perceptions on food choices and consumption. Thus, by analyzing consumers’ tweets, we have studied their points of view regarding the agri-food short supply chain which is supported by the “De la Chacra a la Olla” Peruvian programme. Sentiment analysis was used on the consumers’ tweets along with the Naïve Bayes technique. A total of 1,223 tweets posted between January 2014 and July 2020 were obtained. Our initial findings were that consumers tweets were mainly influenced by context. Furthermore, we conclude that tweets show only informative content related to time and place. Further research is needed to state if the “De la Chacra a la Olla” Peruvian programme is perceived by the consumers as such.

articleTitle: Ransomware scenario oriented financial quantification model for the financial sector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: More and more companies are becoming victims of cyber-attacks and most of these attacks are the result of a ransomware infection. Currently, there are few organizations that perform a quantitative analysis of cyber risks, allowing them to calculate their impact in monetary terms. In this paper, we propose a model with a quantitative approach, so that organizations can express in financial terms the potential impact of a ransomware attack. The proposed model was implemented in a process of a Peruvian company in the financial sector, with which an optimization of 32.2% in cybersecurity investment was achieved.

articleTitle: MonDep App: Monitoring patients with depression using sentiment analysis of therapeutic diary entries
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes MonDep, a web-mobile application for the monitoring of patients with mild and moderate depression based on the PHQ-9 test and the automatic evaluation of therapeutic diary entries. MonDep allows patients to record their daily activities in a therapeutic diary, which is evaluated using sentiment analysis and their results of the PHQ-9 test. This allows the specialist to monitor the progress of the patient's depression treatment through a dashboard. The usability test applied to three depression psychologists shows that they find it user-friendly and easy to access. Due to its usability, low cost, and reliability, this application will be useful for the treatment of depression and will reduce treatment discontinuation.

articleTitle: Leaper: Video Game Development on Android Devices with Cross-Device Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Cross-device interaction is a technology that has increased the relationship between people and the different devices that exist today. This allows users to manipulate information through gestures or body movements. Likewise, the recent demand for smart devices has motivated users to increase their use in different contexts. That is why in this research we propose a platform video game for Android mobile devices called LEAPER. This is a video game that uses the Screen Sharing, Synchronization and Simultaneity design patterns, which allows the user to use several Android operating system devices to interact with each other. In addition, the connectivity of the devices is established by the Pinch gesture. The videogame was tested by 20 users, which have different models of the Android operating system. These participants have successfully demonstrated the cross-device interaction that LEAPER offers.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Information and Internal Communication Systems component of coso III on the profitability of a restaurant of Brasas and Parrillas from Callao 2018
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The Information and Communication component of internal control has been recognized as a tool to manage all types of organizations to obtain reasonable assurance of the achievement of their objectives and to be able to report on their management to the relevant personnel. The administrative department of the permanent private sector is responsible for marketing activities and the exercise of administrative functions. This article is written using quantitative methods, as well as analytical description methods, which leads us to the conclusion: that the implementation of internal control and the timely use of the components of the information and communication system have led to the correct use of organizational resources and strengthened the relationship with organizational management, which will bring better deadlines for the development, approval and execution of the allocated resources.

articleTitle: Common behaviors related to corruption among public university students in Peruvian Andes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This study analyzes the common behaviors of corruption that will serve as a point of discussion regarding the courses or curriculum networks of different programs offered in the academic market. The participants comprised 201 communication sciences university students from two public universities in Junin and Puno. The corruption normalization scale, which measures common behaviors related to corruption, was applied. The results did not show a substantial difference between students from the two distinct regions in Peru, thus indicating that corruption is ingrained. This finding clearly evinces a high tolerance toward different corrupt acts, showing that the absence of values, ethical aspects, and moral norms are the basis of all forms of corruption.

articleTitle: Progressive Application for Route Optimization and Monitoring Processes in Solid Waste Pick-up, Based on Smart Collection Points Using IoT Sensors and the OR-Tools Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: At present, according to MEF (Ministry of Economy and Finance), Peru generates approximately 19 000 tons of municipal solid waste, of which 48% is disposed of in clandestine deposits, which puts people's health at risk and the deterioration of the environment. This study proposes the use of an OR-Tools algorithm, Internet of things and geolocation. These technologies will allow the calculation of the optimal path for solid waste collection, the sending of information in real time from the sensors and the location of the trucks for monitoring; all this based on a progressive web application. The problem identified lies in the inadequate process for collecting and transporting waste by 65.1% of the district municipalities of Metropolitan Lima. This, due to a lack of coverage on the routes, lack of supervision by the municipalities and the mismanagement of officials; generating a negative impact on current collection processes. The validation of the progressive web application was carried out in a controlled urbanization. This was executed by installing sensors that send information to the server in the cloud and it is stored in a database. Subsequently, the algorithm with this information, in conjunction with other parameters, will calculate the optimal route and display it on a map. The driver will view his designated route and the administrator will have general access to all routes, to track by geolocation. This is done in real time, this solving the problems presented at the beginning.

articleTitle: Technological Solution for Logistics Monitoring of Medicines in Peru based on IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Monitoring and obtaining real-time temperature information during the logistics process of cold chain medicines is a current problem in Peru, since currently the information collected is extracted after carrying out the entire transportation process. This research proposes a technological solution with integration of the IoT (Internet of Things) that aims to provide continuous monitoring in real time. In addition, to be able to alert by means of a mobile application when there is an anomaly in the temperature of the transported products. Likewise, achieving a possible improvement in the precision of the data and in the notification time during the process, which were validated through the experiment shown in this research.

articleTitle: Optimization and improvement of bidirectional connections with Web Socket on Synapse framework using Web Workers technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Every year, the demand of Smart Tv increases constantly, same as Android Devices. These devices are used by a lot of population worldwide, but there is not focus on developing apps that uses both platforms. Therefore, is a great opportunity to take advantage of both technologies creating a framework that allows bidirectional connection and interaction between both devices using Web Sockets. This project compares the optimization of search and interconnection of Android devices and LG Smart TVs by reducing the waiting Using Web Workers will allow multi-threaded execution search in Web Socket servers on Android devices much faster. On the other hand, it allows to add multiplayer support to use more than one device at the same time. The result of our project is reduce by 60% the time with parallel search respect to the linear search, and allow the connection to the tv up to 4 players simultaneously. To validate the framework, a video game is developed to test the optimized functionalities in the Web Socket connection in the source code to show the improvements for all devices connected and compare without web workers implementation.

articleTitle: Implementation of a customized content management system for digital marketing based on LG webOS Signage and beacons usage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Due to the way marketing has evolved over time, creating innovative and powerful messages is insufficient. Today, the companies focus on the communication with each customer in a unique way considering its specific preferences, interests, and individual needs. In this context, a variety of digital signage devices is appearing in the market. This type of product has technologies that are not always fully exploited by their manufacturers and end users. This is the case of the LG Digital Signage devices, which are integrated with a beacon (Bluetooth Low Energy technology-BLE) that is not harnessed by the different content management systems available on the market. On this basis, the research team proposes a content management system which can control the information shown in various LG Digital Signage devices. In addition, to customize the experience, the available beacon in the devices was used to create an interaction between the smartphones of the users and the LG Digital Signage monitor, avoiding direct contact with objects that could be manipulated by others. Consuming the information of an external recommendation engine the necessary information can be obtained. In the experiment, many users were asked to try the system to watch general content as well as the customized one in the available monitors. The effectiveness of the system was also evaluated.

articleTitle: Procrastination, academic engagement and the most valued didactic competencies by the high school students in the digital learning context
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The main objective of the present study was to know the relationship between procrastination and academic engagement in secondary school students; in addition, it was sought to identify the most valued didactic competencies by adolescents. The investigation was carried out with a mixed sequential approach, for the quantitative phase there was a sample of 579 students and for the qualitative phase we worked with 21 students. According to the results, procrastination and academic engagement are negatively related, public school students and males present more procrastination. Procrastination is linked to the use of social networks and the best valued didactic competence was the creation and maintain a friendly and empathetic learning environment so that students feel comfortable to participate.

articleTitle: YANA, Virtual Assistant to Support Home Office
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Since the last months of 2019 with the arrival of COVID-19, jobs changed due to confinement; for this reason remote work increased; In a survey carried out among workers from the Universidad de Ciencias y Humanidades, the desire to improve the organization of their work schedule is mentioned, for this reason it was decided to create a virtual assistant, taking into account that virtual assistants and smart devices are increasingly more involved in daily life, devices that can be controlled with the voice, to perform specific activities, in some field of application, the virtual assistant created will help in the organization and recall of events, during remote work, based on these requirements, was born YANA, a virtual assistant developed in Python, which through voice instructions, guides you to organize your work schedule in addition to reminding you of upcoming events, thus managing to provide support in the organization of the agenda, leaving aside the concern of forgetting something Important event; Together with the development of YANA, it was possible to create a user interface, which allows us to control YANA and interact with it, since it is also capable of answering various questions that are asked, as well as the ability to follow a conversation; In the evaluation system developed to evaluate YANA's interaction with users, an average of 7 out of 10 was obtained from a series of questions posed to users.

articleTitle: Design of 50KVA 10 / 0.23KV Distribution Transformers using Aluminum Electrical Conductors to innovate Electrification Projects in the South of Lima
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The research describes the design of a transformer based on aluminum electrical conductors whose properties of conductivity, resistivity, weight and section present us with an innovative alternative for the massive electrification projects developed by the electric power concessionaires. For the design, the theoretical calculations are considered, the dimensioning of the aluminum conductor based on the efficiency of the traditional transformer that uses copper conductors for the electrical substations in the southern area of Lima. For the development of this model, the protocols of seven transformers were used, whose historical data were analyzed and considered to determine the viability, reliability and efficiency of the new 50KVA 10 / 0.23kV transformer ± 5% Dyn5 connection based on aluminum conductors. The results obtained were highly significant considering that the proposed model responds to the protocols of the sample transformers.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Teaching Performance in the Context of Emergency Remote Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: At the international level, guaranteeing educational quality through the evaluation of teaching performance is a priority. In the Peruvian context, these processes are monitored by the National System for the Evaluation and Accreditation of Educational Quality (SINEACE) and by the National Superintendence of Higher Education (SUNEDU). In this context, the purpose of this study is to evaluate the performance of teachers in a professional primary education program at a private university in Lima-Peru in the context of emergency remote teaching. For this purpose, a sample of students of the primary education professional program were surveyed and evaluated a total of 63 subjects taught by a total of 22 teachers. Finally, it was concluded that teachers present optimal levels of performance in the mastery of the course, in the teaching and learning process, in the relationship between teacher and student, in the ethical dimension, and in the humanistic dimension.

articleTitle: Technological solution of psychological therapies using neural networks for the control and monitoring of anxiety disorder
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This article proposes a technological solution for the control and monitoring of anxiety disorder behavior in vulnerable populations that allows receiving symptomatology data, tests and manifestations in real time during psychological therapies The result of this research seeks to optimize the time of attention and to monitor patients in psychological therapies through the use of neural networks and the systematization of psychological tests. This proposal consists of 4 phases: 1. Collection of test results and alerts; 2. Reception of the collected information; 3. The technological solution was validated in a community mental health center in the district of San Martin de Porres in Lima, Peru. Preliminary results showed that technological solution allows to reduce time of psychological therapies by 25% and has an efficiency of 80% based on the tests performed.

articleTitle: TIPI: social robot that incentives good habits to optimize learning at home for children
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The media has spread a notion of what robots should look like and what they should do. This document explores through a qualitative study the characteristics that Peruvian children can perceive and value of a set of robots to generate a list of design requirements. The results showed that children perceive robots as a potential companion that can be part of their daily lives, and that their ideal robot has certain characteristics that their favorite toys also possess. Tipi is a 2 DOF social robot that has an interface that is displayed on its touch screen, which allows the development and monitoring of healthy habits through interaction with the child to contribute to their personal development.

articleTitle: Integration method to protect the privacy and security of information in Process Mining projects: a case study on surgery block
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a method that allows the integration between privacy and understanding of data in Process Mining projects. Due to the latest reports of cyber attacks in health organizations, an integration method is proposed to protect the privacy and security of sensitive information using the discipline of Process Mining. Although there is research of interest related to process mining and data privacy oriented to the health field, there is still a need to protect the security of the information to protect the results and analysis of the processes. The proposed method is an extension of the methodological proposal of process mining projects including data privacy, which consists of four phases: 1. Definition of the project; 2. Data Preparation; 3. Process Analysis; 4. Redesign of Processes. For validation, data from the Surgery Block process of a private health institution in Lima, Peru was used. With the method, it was possible to protect 95% of the process data, obtaining as a result the optimization of the process by 50%.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Classification for Machine Tool Wear Based on Unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: In today's manufacturing industry it is of great importance to know the condition of a tool as it wears out. This knowledge allows us to reduce possible errors and failures in the manufacturing process. This work focuses on classifying the level of wear of a machine tool, allowing us to know its current state using measurements of forces and accelerations. First, tool wear levels are obtained by unsupervised learning (through the Gaussian mixture model). Then a convolutional neural network trained directly using the measured time series predicts the level of tool wear. After careful selection of the optimal window length, optimization algorithm, and number of epochs, wear levels were predicted with accuracy greater than 85%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection of Suspicions of COVID-19 Using X-Ray Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: At the beginning of 2020, the World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic, since in all the countries of the world efforts have been made to stop the rate of infections, with the isolation of the population; Peru was one of the countries with strict isolation, however we are about to experience a third wave; on May 2021, Peru has a fatality rate of 3.55%, it is the 5<sup>th</sup> country with the most deaths in Latin America and the Caribbean and 15<sup>th</sup> worldwide. A rapid identification of COVID-19 cases is necessary, for this reason an algorithm has been developed for the identification of CODID-19 in addition to bacterial and viral pneumonia through x-ray images; also, the development of a graphical interface, which helps to quickly diagnose suspected COVID-19 cases. The results shown are optimistic since a rate of approximately 80% has been achieved, however, work continues to further improve the efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Dice Combat: Development of a dice combat video game for mobile devices Using Ensemble Interactions patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Having more than one mobile device at home or a person using more than one device to perform the same activity are trends that have become common these days. In view of this, it is useful that more applications today allow interconnectivity and complementarity between more than one device to improve the experience when performing a particular activity, however, this popularity has not yet fully permeated the mobile gaming sector. Applying these features to mobile video games would result in a better gaming experience by allowing to take advantage of each device in the home. This article proposes a video game for Android mobile devices called Dice Combat, which has the theme of conquest of empires, where the units are made up of dice and three Android mobile devices connected to the same local network are required to carry out a game. With this proposal it is expected to demonstrate that the use of several connected devices, as well as the use of the accelerometer to exchange information between them through the shaking gesture, can enrich the gaming experience.

articleTitle: Structural characterization of ecommerce for its growth and development in Peru
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The objective of this study was to determine those key variables or factors that characterize ecommerce in Peru and will drive its growth and development to reach the turnover levels of the main Latin American economies. In this sense, a PEST analysis was conducted to identify the most relevant variables of the system studied. Then, based on an exploratory and descriptive design, a structural analysis (French strategic foresight technique) was carried out with the participation of 5 experts in ecommerce and digital media. Likewise, the MICMAC tool (Matrix of Cross Impacts Multiplication Applied to a Classification) was used to determine the levels of motricity and dependency of each proposed variable. The results identified consumer electronics culture as the most sensitive variable and, to a lesser extent, the variables of ecommerce application development, consumer banking and consumer distrust. Furthermore, it was found that the COVID 19 pandemic has had a positive impact on the adoption of ecommerce in Peru. Finally, this study constitutes a starting point for the planning and design of future scenarios for the behavior of the ecommerce system in Peru in the medium and long term.

articleTitle: Allocation criteria for scarce resources during the Covid-19 pandemic: the case of peruvian indigenous leaders
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This article discusses and analyzes various criteria used for the allocation of scarce resources, such as ICU beds, in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic. It argues the need to evaluate the allocation of ICU beds through a decisional methodology of multiple criteria, as well as the importance of discussing the inclusion of the criterion that emphasizes the value of the person, which, interpreted in a broad sense, would allow the inclusion of indigenous leaders and not only health personnel.

articleTitle: Fire risk zone analysis system using a predictive model for time and resource optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a predictive solution to optimize the time of analysis for the identification of fire risk areas. This proposal consists of two applications: mobile and web. Both applications have functionalities that allow the user to obtain information about the identified risk areas: (1) Fire Register, (2) Risk Zone Register, (3) Display of available resources, (4) Display of fire risk zones, (5) Consultation of emergencies attended to in the last 24 hours and (6) Notification in the event of proximity to a risk zone. The proposal is described in three sections: (1) the optimization of the current process of analysis and identification of fire risk zones, (2) the functionalities of the web and mobile solution, (3) the implementation of the predictive analysis and (4) the designed technological architecture. The validation of the proposal consisted of two parts (1) Validation of the web application in conjunction with INDECI members, with data and records of fires that we obtained from the institution for the analysis of risk areas and (2) Validation of the mobile application that was conducted with 20 users to identify the time of search for risk areas. The results showed that the time of the analysis process was optimized by 75%, while the search time by 90.6%, which mainly generates a social benefit to the citizens by ensuring the quick and efficient identification of fire risk zones, based on a predictive analysis.

articleTitle: Intercultural Attitudes in Pedagogy University Students
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Intercultural education has been developing at the international level with greater acceptance, but its implementation requires timely knowledge of the attitudes in favor or against it. For these reasons, the objective of the study was to interpret the intercultural attitudes presented by university students in the fourth cycle of pedagogy during the beginning and end of an academic semester at a private university in Lima-Peru. The sample consisted of 74 students who completed a questionnaire of 17 items grouped in the dimensions of racist prejudice, cultural prejudice, and the perception of intercultural education. Finally, it can be concluded that there are acceptable and good intercultural attitudes in university student teachers of a private university during the beginning and end of an academic semester, but not significant.

articleTitle: A Method for Data Collection and Comparison of UVI Sources for Supervised Learning Task
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Ultraviolet radiation is responsible for premature aging, melanomas, carcinomas and a large number of cases of skin cancer, despite the fact that it is the easiest risk factor to prevent in people. There are sources such as web and mobile applications and even industrial instruments that claim to measure the UV radiation index (UVI). In this work, four experiments were conducted to evaluate the relationship of the UV radiation index (UVI) with time and climatic variables such as humidity, temperature and sky condition. We found industrial instrument indicates lower radiation values, since it has a sensor that is affected by various climatic factors, while the applications that use the Global Positioning System (GPS) indicate high values. However, it was also determined that the margin of error of these is tolerable for taking preventive measures. We contribute with a collected data set of UVI and weather condition in Peru.

articleTitle: Benefits of Gamified Evaluations for Virtual Education in Pandemic Context According to the Peruvian Teachers Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Faced with the current pandemic context, in which virtual education has prevailed in most countries, this exploratory research aims to determine the Peruvian teachers' perception about the benefits of using gamified tools for learning assessment. 110 teachers of different educational levels participated, of which 80% were women (88) and 20% men (22), aged between 21 and 61 years. A questionnaire was applied to them to measure the benefits of 5 dimensions: effectiveness, motivation, performance, ubiquity and satisfaction. The results provide an overview of the gamification benefits, but they also reveal differences in the benefits according to educational levels (kindergarten, primary, secondary, and higher education).

articleTitle: Design approach of a trout egg sorting machine based on convolutional neural networks with water conditions monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Today's rainbow trout egg farming process is still a manual labor. This costs a great amount of resources and time for the fish farmers that take care of this specie. Along the Peruvian rainbow trout egg value chain, the most critical aspect is the death rate that results in lower productivity and, in consequence, lower income for this type of activity. The following article describes the design of two systems: a trout egg sorting machine and a trout egg incubator. The first one includes microcontrollers, electric pumps, computer vision features, sensors, valves and pipes. The other one consists of pipes, valves and sensors. The main aim of this current project is to help rainbow trout egg farmers by providing them a modern way to separate dead fish eggs from the living ones through a Convolutional Neural Network, which is a multilayered architecture and allows to focus on the most relevant features in the image processing. Then, keep the amount of live fish eggs in an appropriate incubator, all together with a group of sensors located around the eggs in order to preserve them for the next step in the rainbow trout hatching. The results showed that the data from the water parameters could be visualize through an user interface and the trout egg classification made by the trained model achieved a maximum accuracy of 95% during the training process.

articleTitle: An Inductive Method for Teaching Legal Reasoning and Argumentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This article draws a distinction between the teaching of theories of legal argumentation, on the one hand, and practical legal reasoning and argumentation, on the other. While the theories of legal argumentation represent an analytical-conceptual reflection on the practice of reasoning in different contexts, legal reasoning and argumentation is a practical skill that is put into operation through the simulation of argumentative contexts. In this way, the teaching of legal reasoning and argumentation can be developed more effectively from an inductive methodology, in which from the simulation of realistic contexts of argumentation, guidelines are extracted for a better approach and defense of arguments.

articleTitle: Digital skills, teacher's leadership styles and academic performance in the digital learning context
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The main objective of the present study was to know the relationship between teachers digital skills, teachers leadership styles and academic performance of secondary school students; in addition, it was sought to identify the main challenges faced by teachers with a transformational leadership style in the context of virtual classes. The investigation was carried out with a mixed sequential approach; for the quantitative phase there was a sample of 189 high school teachers and for the qualitative phase we worked with 22 teachers. According to the results, A positive relationship was found between teacher's digital skills and student's academic performance. A positive relationship was also found between the teacher's transformational leadership style and the students' academic performance. Additionally, teachers from public educational institutions obtained higher scores in the transformational style than those from private institutions. On the other hand, it was reported that the main challenge identified was in the way of teaching, this changes forced teachers to leave their comfort zone.

articleTitle: Gender Stereotypes about Women in the Fitness World on Instagram
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This study aims to analyze gender stereotypes about women in the fitness world on the social network Instagram. The purpose is to identify the different normalized gender stereotypes and thus find the reason for this phenomenon in order to understand. This study will use terms such as preconceived ideas, attitudes assigned to each person based on their gender and socialization. As for the methodology, an interpretive paradigm of qualitative approach is applied, with a case study where interviews will be used as a data collection technique and the instruments will be in-depth interviews with the Instagram audience. Finally, it can be seen that we have a generation that is eradicating certain gender stereotypes due to cultural changes in society. However, there are other stereotypes deeply rooted in our culture that place women at a disadvantage.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Virtual Performance of Teachers of the Professional Career of Initial Education of a Private University in Lima - Peru
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: A good university training of future professionals in education as in other specialty, is one of the concerns that the university has whether state or private; so it is necessary to know how teachers perform in the management of their different classes or learning sessions, even more when we find that university studies have to be virtual, both synchronously and asynchronously, using platforms such as Zoom and the use of other platforms such as Moodle. The study aimed to know the performance of 31 teachers (20 women (64.5 %) and 11 men (35.5 %) through a virtual survey conducted to 540 students in this case of the professional school of initial education; through an instrument consisting of 5 dimensions, which are related to the activity of the teacher in their virtual classes such as: Course mastery, teaching-learning processes, student-teacher relationship, Ethics and Humanistic, Finally, with the results it was concluded that teachers have an optimal performance in teaching and pedagogical management; but significant deficiencies in research and intellectual production.

articleTitle: Perception of Leadership Styles and Teaching Performance at a University of Lima
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Leadershipstyles such as theleader's ability to influence the members of an organization. The style will depend on the adoption of the personality of the manager and can be charismatic, transactional, transformational and authentic, while the teaching performance is conceived as the professional capacity of a university teacher who performs his function showing suitability, interpersonal relationships, technological mastery and training in ethical values. The focus of the research was qualitative, type grounded theory, being the sample 10 teachers with the aim of analyzing the Perception of leadership styles and teaching performance at a University of Lima 2019, the instrument an unstructured, open questionnaire. Among the main results is evidenced the thematic axis varied leadership style assumed by academic managers, the trend being the transformational style and in the thematic axis teaching performance is evidenced little university accompaniment by managers with regard to professional responsibility, interpersonal relationships, technological mastery and training in values; however, teachers perform their mandated functions. The conclusion was that the perception of leadership styles is varied, but the trend is contextualized in an academic manager of transformational style, in connection with a teaching performance little motivated but that presents a tendency to fulfill his professional responsibility, interpersonal relations, technological mastery and training in ethical values.

articleTitle: ProstaTest: A System for the Diagnosis of Prostate Cancer Based on IPSS, PSA, and Ultrasound Scan
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Prostate cancer is the fifth most common cause of cancer death in men. In 2020, more than 375 thousand deaths attributed to this disease were reported. Nevertheless, these numbers could be drastically reduced if key procedures for early diagnosis such as digital rectal examination are used. However, despite its benefits, low participation in digital rectal examination remains a significant burden due to masculinity beliefs. An alternative to overcome this difficulty is the use of ultrasound scanning and deep learning methods for its processing. Other procedures used for detecting this type of cancer with high probability are the Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) and the International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS). Indeed, using such procedures combined will allow higher accuracy in the diagnosis. Therefore, we propose ProstaTest, a system for non-invasive detection of prostate cancer based on IPSS, PSA and prostate ultrasound scanning applying Deep Learning, which altogether allows obtaining an automatic diagnosis with high accuracy. ProstaTest, with 48 ultrasound scans and 23 medical records, shows an accuracy of 96% in detecting prostate inflammation and 95.65% in diagnosing prostate cancer.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Prototype Based in 2D Blocks with Multiple Shapes for Teaching Computer Programming to Visually Impaired Children
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes the implementation of a prototype based in physical 2D blocks with multiple shapes for teaching computer programming to visually impaired children. The image processing techniques used, the source code generation and compilation process, and design of human-machine interfaces are presented. The results showed that using space color change technique is possible to get a standard C++ code program since a development environment based in physical blocks where the compilation results can be communicated throws of voice. Finally, some examples of programs that can be implemented through the prototype and the corresponding conclusions are provided.

articleTitle: Study of the Anxiety level during COVID-19 in pregnant women of the Ascensión Health Center – Huancavelica - Peru 2021
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)

authors.preferredName: Cintya Karina Quispe De La Cruz

abstract: This quantitative exploratory study analyzes the anxiety level in pregnant women from an Andean town in Huancavelica and its causes and possible effects. Objective: Determine the anxiety level in pregnant women from the Ascensión Health Center - Huancavelica 2021. Methods: A prospective observational study was carried out, descriptive level. In 270 pregnant women; AAD Zung observation and test sheet instruments. Results: 64.4% presented anxiety, 58.5% (158) minimal to moderate and 5.9% (16) marked to severe. The most affected were non-health professionals and students, 20% and 15.97% of marked to severe anxiety, and 50% and 63.64% minimal to moderate, housewives and independent workers presented 3.45% and 3.23% marked to severe anxiety, and 57.47% and 70.97% minimal to moderate; 100% of the unemployed presented minimal to moderate anxiety. It has been identified that 88.51% have an income ≤ 1000 PEN per month and are the ones that present the most anxiety, 38.89% (105) had relatives who suffered from COVID-19, of which 12.38% presented marked to severe anxiety and the 71.43% presented minimal to moderate anxiety; of 9.63% their relatives were hospitalized, of them 11.54% had marked to severe anxiety and 84.62% minimal to moderate anxiety; the 14.81% of the pregnant women, a relative died from COVID-19, of them 20% presented marked to severe anxiety and 80% minimal to moderate anxiety. 35.19% (95) suffered from COVID-19, of them 81.25% had marked to severe anxiety and 47.47% had minimal to moderate anxiety. Conclusions: pregnant women with the most anxiety were those with the lowest income and were directly or indirectly affected by COVID-19, it is urgent to incorporate preventive measures.

articleTitle: From the mechanical muse to the electronic muse: A media archeology on Peruvian poetry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This research aims to show how the work of rescue and remediation of the corpus of Peruvian electronic poetry raises the need for a methodology that, based on data clusters and their connections through links, allows to recognize the non-linear relationships that underlie the works of Peruvian authors who experimented with analog and electronic media during the 20th century. To do this, we propose a methodology that integrates data visualization with genealogical research. The importance of this project lies in the fact that the proposed methodology to analyze the works is an innovation in the field of literature.

articleTitle: Family, economic and pedagogical factors involved in dropping out of school and the consequences for students of a private institution in Lima - Peru
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: School dropout in primary education is a problem that has individual and social economic repercussions. In view of this problem, the objective of this research was to analyze factors and consequences of school dropout in primary education in a private educational institution in the district of Carabayllo (Lima - Peru). Assuming a qualitative methodology, six elementary school teachers were interviewed (3 males and 3 females) and after a coding and triangulation analysis, the following results were obtained: it is confirmed that the factors in school dropout (family, economic and pedagogical) influence the students’ decision making, thus interrupting their educational training. The pedagogical factor such as methodological deficiencies, inadequate training and teacher treatment influence school dropout. Finally, the consequences of dropping out present difficulties both in the present and future life of the student and also in society.

articleTitle: Taxonomy of Interaction Techniques based on F-Formation Patterns for developing Cross Device Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: Collaboration environments provide the necessary tools to conduct a meeting and perform tasks together through devices and interaction techniques. Currently, investigations about Proxemics and F-Formation patterns show how these concepts can be used to improve the interaction between people and devices, considering the distance between them. However, there is not a broad perspective respect to use them with Cross Device. In this paper, a taxonomy of interaction techniques based on F-Formation patterns is proposed in order to be used as a guide of good practices for the development of future Cross Device Applications.

articleTitle: Reading of classic books and development of skills: An experience with Law students
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The article analyzes the competencies related to the level of academic achievement in the course Introduction to Law, measured from the reading of the books Ethics for Amador and The Social Contract. The study was of a basic non-experimental cross-sectional type, a questionnaire was applied to measure the level of achievement of competencies through a Likert scale. It is proposed that the guided reading of the chosen books contributes to the development of competencies in the Law students of the Universidad Privada del Norte. The categorical qualitative variables, Level of Achievement and Performance Criteria of Competencies, were analyzed by means of the Chi-Square statistic that sought to determine the relationship, dependence, association or influence between variables. It was concluded that there are performance criteria of competencies that have a significant relationship with the level of academic achievement of the participating students.

articleTitle: Emancipatory action of teaching praxis in critical pedagogy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: The aim to this study is to show how critical pedagogy as an emancipatory action of educational praxis from teachers’ experience. Extensive interviews with 10 key members of the School of Communication at a private university in Peru were conducted. For the investigation, the interview technique was applied and the in-depth interview guide served as an instrument. This data was analyzed using ATLAS.ti software, employing a process of author analogies. As a result, this study considers that it is fundamental to train teachers how to apply critical pedagogy as an emancipatory action. This action transforms the realities and generates a new dynamic in the university context that should mobilize the formative dynamics of the academia context.

articleTitle: Technological Context of Kindergarten Education Teachers in Peru before E-teaching due to covid-19. Prepandemic Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: This study with a quantitative, descriptive and trend approach aims to determine the situation of technological resources that kindergarten teachers had in Peru, just before the transition to e-teaching due to covid-19. To do this, three Surveys to Peruvian Teachers (ENDO) carried out by Ministerio de Educacion del Peru before the pandemic, in 2014, 2016 and 2018 were analyzed. The total of kindergarten teachers who participated in each year, respectively, were: 1593 (74.2 % = urban, 25.8 % = rural), 1759 (76.8 % = urban, 23.2 % = rural) and 2935 (82.2 % = urban, 17.8 % = rural). After analyzing the three variables that make up the technological context dimension (electricity access, technological devices access and internet access) it can be concluded that the trends, in general, were positive, but insufficient, especially in terms of internet access, and especially in the rural areas of the Peruvian jungle.

articleTitle: IoT technological model to improve the control and monitoring of patients with eating disorders (ED): Anorexia and Bulimia in a mental health hospital
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: According to statistics from different entities, in Peru, anorexia and bulimia are the most frequent diagnosed eating disorders (ED) every year. Therefore, this study proposes a technological model based on Internet of Things for the control and monitoring of patients with anorexia. This model will allow the control and monitoring through IoT devices that will collect patient data associated to mental, physical and nutritional health. This will allow specialists to have greater availability of patient data that on traditional methods is handled through a diary written by the patient, who does not always comply with the daily registration of these. In addition, the model provides data processing in order to give recommendations and alerts to the doctor based on the patient's data. Likewise, the study has been validated with specialists, who participated by comparing the availability, satisfaction and effectiveness of monitoring before and after using the technological model. As a result, the study shows that with the implementation of the technological model, the efficacy of the control and monitoring process increased by 52%.

articleTitle: Video Activism and Social Movements: Online Reception of “The Revolution and the Land” Trailer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Sciences and Humanities International Research Conference (SHIRCON)
abstract: “The Revolution and the Land” is a 110-minute documentary, released in Peruvian cinemas on October 10th, 2019. The film deals with the background and consequences of the promulgation of the Agrarian Reform Law by the president Juan Velasco Alvarado on June 24th, 1969. To analyze the social discourses generated around the documentary, we analyzed the official trailer available on YouTube This 2-minute 30 seconds video was chosen because of the relevance that the internet has acquired for the dissemination of this work, as well as its characteristics to promote video activism: the high number of users, the ease to include information about the documentary and by offering content related to social issues. At the time of this study, the documentary had 254 260 views, 3 967 likes and 123 dislikes. To analyze the reception of the documentary and explore the commitment to social change, 952 comments were analyzed according to the following categories: visibility and reach, frames and values, affinity and support, communicative practices. After the analysis, it is concluded that the official trailer for the documentary “The Revolution and the Land” is a success story of video activism and communication for peaceful social change. However, while the comments reveal the interest generated by the documentary's release, the detailed analysis reveals a tense debate that oscillates between the vindication of social movements and their disqualification. In this way, video activism is allowing different social actors to have new spaces for political action through the audiovisual.
